definitions.explanation: A reverent word for the soul of a dead person, or the spirit of a god. Used in prayers, funerals and Shinto rites.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御霊|みたま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: To offer prayers to the spirit of the deceased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御霊|みたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慰|なぐさ}める→慰める：02133_nagusameru⟧。
examples.english: To console the spirits of the war dead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御霊|みたま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}らか→安らか：12237_yasuraka⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧よう、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせた→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: The whole family put their hands together in prayer that our late grandfather's soul would rest in peace.

notes:
USAGE:
Formal and reverent; heard in funeral speeches, memorial ceremonies and Shinto rites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {御霊|みたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慰|なぐさ}める→慰める：02133_nagusameru⟧: to console the spirit of the dead
- {御霊|みたま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray to the spirit
- {御霊|みたま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祀|まつ}る: to enshrine a spirit

WATCH OUT:
- The same kanji are read ごりょう for the vengeful spirits of Heian-period belief ({御霊信仰|ごりょうしんこう}), and ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ on a condolence envelope is read ごれいぜん.
